title: EgoSAT: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Egocentric Streaming Interaction Understanding
why_it_matters: **Past-only interaction reasoning**: Retrospective, ongoing, and prospective questions share one benchmark, and each query may use only frames observed so far.
verification_note: Classification based on the paper abstract and project page; implementation not independently audited.

title: EGOSTREAM: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Streaming Episodic Memory in Egocentric Vision
why_it_matters: **Answer validity windows**: Recall is scored across time so that model forgetting can be separated from answers that stop being true as the scene changes.
verification_note: Classification based on the paper and project page; implementation not independently audited.

title: S-EMBER: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Streaming Egocentric Memory Retrieval
why_it_matters: **Grounded causal recall**: On 388 hours of smart-glasses video, an answer must use only frames from before the query time and point to a supporting interval.
verification_note: Query-time cutoff is stated in the paper abstract and project README. Links recorded from those pages on 2026-10-27; not independently rerun.

title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking cross-Session Persistent Memory for Real-World Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
why_it_matters: **Memory that survives interruptions**: Sessions in one life trajectory stop and resume, so the assistant must store, reuse, and admit missing evidence instead of rereading one continuous file.
verification_note: Streaming and egocentric setting follow the paper and project page. The exact future-frame rule inside a session was not re-audited.

title: Keep It in Mind: User-Centric Continual Spatial Intelligence Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
why_it_matters: **Spatial memory that moves with the wearer**: DirectMe updates a structured map from the first-person stream so later questions can recover where objects were after the camera has moved.
verification_note: Online timestamped QA is stated by the authors. User-centric here means spatial reference to the wearer, not a preference or identity profile, so the primary question is memory rather than personalization.

title: TeleEgo: Benchmarking Egocentric AI Assistants in the Wild
interaction: Streaming QA under a decision window
why_it_matters: **Right answer, inside the window**: Long in-the-wild egocentric streams are scored with real-time accuracy and a memory-persistence measure across recall, current understanding, and cross-event reasoning.
verification_note: Authors describe a strict streaming evaluation with synchronized video, audio, and text. Future-frame leakage was not independently audited. Primary question is long-horizon memory because that is the gap the benchmark emphasizes.

title: LightMem-Ego: Your AI Memory for Everyday Life
interaction: Query routed to a memory level
why_it_matters: **Three speeds of wearable memory**: Egocentric video and audio share one timeline and are split into current, short-term, and long-term stores before a query is answered.
verification_note: Continuous capture is author-described in a systems/demo paper. Latency, leakage, and on-device behavior were not reproduced.

title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding
why_it_matters: **Long-horizon memory without a streaming audit**: Useful for telling multi-day egocentric reasoning apart from a causal online evaluation.
verification_note: Kept in Related until a test-time observation cutoff is checked against the full paper.

title: EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant
why_it_matters: **A recorded week of wearable life**: Six people wear glasses for a week so an assistant can recall events and habits; the original benchmark is long-context assistance, not a verified causal stream.
verification_note: Later streaming benchmarks reuse EgoLife questions. This entry does not treat EgoRAG or whole-week retrieval as causal streaming.

title: Evaluating Memory Capability in Continuous Lifelog Scenario
interaction: Causal QA over stored lifelog chunks
audio_role: Dialogue text from wearable audio or EgoLife summaries
why_it_matters: **No future session in the answer**: Memory is frozen before each query on dialogue lifelogs, including an EgoLife-derived subset, but the evaluated stream is text rather than raw frames.
verification_note: The online protocol explicitly blocks future chunks. Related, not Core, because the model consumes transcribed or summarized lifelogs rather than a first-person video stream. The EgoMem subset here is not the lifelong audiovisual agent of the same short name.

title: StreamArena: Toward Continuous, Interactive, and Long-Horizon Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
audio_role: Audio-visual streams; ego capture not claimed
why_it_matters: **Recent frames are not long memory**: On hour-scale videos, keeping only the latest frames misses distant events, which is a useful control even though the videos are not first-person.
verification_note: Included as a non-egocentric streaming benchmark. StreamMind is the accompanying system. Viewpoint was not found to be egocentric.

title: EgoSelf: From Memory to Personalized Egocentric Assistant
why_it_matters: **A graph of this person's habits**: Past egocentric interactions become a user-specific profile that predicts future interactions; a causal frame-by-frame protocol is not established.
verification_note: Personalization is explicit. Streaming evidence was not found in the abstract, so the entry stays Related. The project page is the code pointer given by the authors; a separate repository was not recorded.

title: EgoMem: Lifelong Memory Agent for Full-duplex Omnimodal Models
viewpoint: Embodied audiovisual; wearable viewpoint not verified
why_it_matters: **Facts, preferences, and relationships from the live stream**: A full-duplex model recognizes people and updates long-term user knowledge without a separate text memory log.
verification_note: Real-time audiovisual operation is author-described. Face and voice recognition may be a view of other people rather than a verified wearable first-person camera, so this is Related rather than Core.

title: EgoAVU: Egocentric Audio-Visual Understanding
why_it_matters: **Tie the sound to the visible action**: Large-scale egocentric narrations and questions test whether a model uses audio instead of answering from vision alone; a causal streaming protocol is not established.
verification_note: CVPR 2026 highlight per the authors' code repository. Whole-clip audio-visual QA is not treated as streaming.

title: Listening with the Eyes: Benchmarking Egocentric Co-Speech Grounding across Space and Time
memory_horizon: A clip and a gesture stroke
audio_role: Speech aligned to a pointing gesture
why_it_matters: **What, where, and when for the word that**: A deictic command is executable only if speech is bound to the pointing stroke, which is the grounding question even though the clips are not an ongoing stream.
verification_note: Evaluation is on annotated clips with millisecond stroke windows, not a verified always-on streaming protocol.

title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
why_it_matters: **Intervene or stay silent**: Links a changing wearer context and retrieved memory to the decision of whether assistance should happen now.
verification_note: Online setting follows the paper and project page. Exact leakage and latency were not fully audited.

title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
why_it_matters: **Remember without being asked**: The assistant has to notice transient details, object-state changes, and moves in time, from one notification up to a memory tool it starts and stops itself.
verification_note: Primary question is proactive initiation. The payload is memory, so it also informs the memory category. Future-frame access was not independently audited.

title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
audio_role: First-person video plus reconstructed instructor speech
why_it_matters: **Speak, or stay quiet, in voice**: At each moment of a first-person video and audio stream the model either remains silent or gives spoken guidance without being asked.
verification_note: The silence-or-speak target is author-described on HoloAssist-derived streams. Audio is reconstructed instructor speech, not a claim of raw always-on microphone capture. Latency was not reproduced.

title: Eyes Wide Open: Ego Proactive Video-LLM for Streaming Video
why_it_matters: **Just-in-time proactive QA**: Scores both the answer and whether it is issued at the moment it becomes appropriate on an egocentric stream.
verification_note: Paper and public code checked as links. Proactivity here is answer timing, not necessarily unsolicited need discovery. Venue is recorded as NeurIPS 2025 from the authors' public listing.

title: Plan, Watch, Recover: A Benchmark and Architectures for Proactive Procedural Assistance
why_it_matters: **When to interrupt, and how to recover**: Estimates procedural state from wearable video, decides whether to coach, and supplies a way back when the wearer leaves the plan.
verification_note: EgoProactive is wearable egocentric video. Pro2Bench also reformulates mixed sources, including HowTo100M, so not every evaluated video is first-person. Data and code are the Hugging Face release named by the authors.

title: Proactive Assistant Dialogue Generation from Streaming Egocentric Videos
why_it_matters: **Streaming procedural dialogue**: Generates guidance from egocentric video and can remain silent until a step needs help.
verification_note: Code repository recorded from the project page. Deployment and runtime claims were not reproduced. Venue is recorded as EMNLP 2025 from the authors' public listing.

title: EgoSpeak: Learning When to Speak for Egocentric Conversational Agents in the Wild
why_it_matters: **When a first-person agent should start talking**: Predicts speech initiation online from untrimmed egocentric video, before any user question has been asked.
verification_note: Authors list first-person RGB, online processing, and untrimmed video as design requirements. The exact no-future-frame implementation was not re-audited. Venue is recorded as NAACL 2025 from the authors' public listing.

title: PROVIA: Procedure State Tracking for Online Mistake Detection in Egocentric Videos
why_it_matters: **An alarm from past frames only**: Procedure state is tracked causally, a mistake can be flagged before the next step, and the tracker continues after the person recovers.
verification_note: The paper states that detection uses past frames on complete trials and reports 58-70 FPS. That throughput was not reproduced here. Primary question is procedural error detection rather than spoken assistance.

title: PREGO: Online Mistake Detection in PRocedural EGOcentric Videos
why_it_matters: **Expected next step versus the step just seen**: An online recognizer reads frames up to time t and a language model predicts the next step from earlier steps, so an unseen mistake is a mismatch.
verification_note: The paper states that recognition at time t does not use future frames. Included as the online procedural-error baseline for this question.

title: EgoRecall: 3D Visual Grounding from Streaming Egocentric Observations
interaction: Referring expression at a query frame
why_it_matters: **Ground the phrase from the walk so far**: A referring expression is resolved in 3D using only the egocentric views available at the query time, including objects that have left the frame.
verification_note: No arXiv id was found on 2026-10-27; the project page is the paper link. Queries are defined on the observation history at that timestamp. Scenes are static ScanNet++ walkthroughs, so this does not test changing object state. Code was listed as forthcoming, not recorded as released.

title: VideoLLM-online: Online Video Large Language Model for Streaming Video
why_it_matters: **Silence token on a live narration stream**: The model learns to speak or stay silent as frames arrive, and Ego4D narration is a main streaming test, but the model is not egocentric-only.
verification_note: Related because the system is a general streaming video LLM. It is listed here as the usual baseline for online egocentric narration, not as a first-person method.

title: Intention-Guided Cognitive Reasoning for Egocentric Long-Term Action Anticipation
memory_horizon: Observed context, then a future horizon
why_it_matters: **Intention before the next actions**: Hand-object cues and an explicit think-reason-answer step forecast a long egocentric action sequence; frames are not shown to arrive as an always-on stream.
verification_note: Standard long-term anticipation on Ego4D, EPIC-Kitchens, and EGTEA. Prefix observation is not treated as a streaming-assistant protocol.
